request:
镜头 s22：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 8 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：资料影像，有噪点和色彩偏移，手持。昏暗的机房里一排排显示器接连亮起，筋疲力尽、浑身湿透的技术员举起手臂欢呼、互相拥抱。环境声：失真的欢呼声和掌声。
情绪：euphoric, exhausted, relieved
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium wide shot, handheld news camera with jerky reframing
景深与虚实：Archival softness, the bright monitors blooming.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival 2058 news footage: in a dark control room beside the flooded hall, rows of monitors flicker and light up one after another; exhausted technicians in wet clothes raise their arms and hug. Blocking lock: rows of monitors recede from frame left to the background; technicians stand at frame right and centre, some raising their arms.
Picture 2: the staging area of the 2058 root-server restart operation (location reference; role: location reference). A staging area at the edge of a flooded underground root-server facility in 2058: floodlights on tripods glaring off black water that covers the floor, concrete pillars, coils of cable, open equipment cases, diving helmets and air tanks on a tarp, a temporary railing at the water's edge. Empty of people, urgent, cold.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：distorted cheering, clapping, a monitor power-up whine
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the storyboard keyframe of an archival 2058 control-room shot from <Picture 1>, serving as composition, lighting and blocking reference. A dark control room beside a flooded hall: rows of boxy CRT monitors on metal racks flicker and light up one after another, their pale green-white glow the only real light source, spilling onto wet concrete floor and wet shoulders of the people standing among the racks. Palette: murky black, cold monitor green-white, blown-out hot highlights on screens, a smear of red warning lamp at the far end. Light is uneven, screens blooming into halos, faces lit from below by the monitors. Blocking lock: rows of monitors recede from frame left into the background depth; technicians stand at frame right and centre, several with arms raised, two of them embracing slightly right of frame centre; foreground bottom-left is the wet dark edge of a monitor rack.
<Subject 2> is the staging area at the edge of the flooded underground root-server facility (2058) from <Picture 2>, serving as location reference. A staging area at the edge of a flooded underground root-server facility: floodlights on tripods glaring off black water that covers the floor, thick square concrete pillars, coils of cable on the ground, open equipment cases, diving helmets and air tanks laid on a tarp, a temporary railing at the water's edge, everything damp and cold-toned. Layout reads as a large underground concrete hall with water standing on the floor; the adjoining control room is entered from this hall and shares the concrete pillars, the wet floor and the harsh floodlight spill. Empty of people, urgent, cold.

summary:
Archival 2058 broadcast news footage from inside a dark control room beside the flooded hall: rows of monitors flicker and light up one after another, and exhausted, soaked technicians raise their arms in cheers and hug each other. Handheld, noisy, chroma-smeared tape footage of a victory the operators can barely stand up for. Final frame: a medium wide view of the lit monitor rows with technicians still holding their arms up and embracing, the bright screens blooming.

retention_analysis:

<Subject 2> (appears in this shot): fully_preserved — environment, lighting and layout retained as the location: concrete pillars, standing water, cable coils, floodlight glare and the cold urgent tone.

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 8.0s, 24fps, archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium wide shot, shoulder-held ENG news camera with one jerky handheld re-frame, starting on the receding rows of monitors at frame left and nudging right and slightly closer to settle on the technicians at frame right and centre, the framing imperfect and drifting throughout. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: rows of monitors recede from frame left into the background depth, technicians stand at frame right and centre in wet clothes, the wet dark edge of a monitor rack sits in the foreground bottom-left. Start: the room is almost black, one monitor at the far end of the row pops into life with a pale green-white glow, then the next and the next, the light travelling down the racks toward the camera. Middle: the rising screen light catches wet shoulders and faces; a technician near frame centre pushes himself upright off the rack he was leaning on, lifts both arms above his head and shouts, and the woman beside him turns and throws an arm around his back; the camera jerks to follow them, a hot screen edge flaring across the frame. End: the whole row of monitors is lit, the technicians at frame right still stand with arms up and two of them locked in an embrace, chests heaving, one bending forward with hands on knees and then straightening again; the camera settles a beat late, leaving the framing slightly crooked. Mood: euphoric, exhausted, relieved. Blur: archival softness overall, the bright monitors blooming into halos, foreground rack edge and far background dissolving into murky grain while faces at mid-distance stay just readable. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Distorted cheering and clapping bouncing off concrete, a monitor power-up whine rising as the screens come on, electrical hum from the racks, dripping water, wet shoes shuffling on the concrete floor, close breath of exhausted people, a distant metallic clang from the flooded hall; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
